description: RF-DETR Medium (rfdetr 1.8.3). Settings not listed are rfdetr 1.8.3 defaults (e.g. weight decay 1e-4, lr_vit_layer_decay 0.8, clip_max_norm 0.1).

notes.batch: batch 1 with 9 accumulated micro-batches (effective batch 9, Table XI); accumulation correction in symbolrec/patches.py
notes.input: each training view (strip or whole page) is resized to a 2048 x 2048 square; no random augmentation

branch_HandSchA.classes: every class with at least one training target (L > 200, at least 90% of the box visible in a strip); classes.json of prepare_rfdetr.py, in category id order
branch_HandSchA.data: prepare_rfdetr.py --mode strips: targets L > 200, full-width strips 768/384, visible area >= 90%
branch_HandSchA.initialization: init_rfdetr.py --layout branch (seed 0; one initialization for both training seeds of a split)
branch_HandSchA.checkpoint: select_rfdetr.py: snapshots every 10 epochs, the last epoch and the best native-validation checkpoint, scored by the L > 200 micro-AP50 of the branch classes on whole validation pages (earlier epoch on ties)

branch_MUSCIMA++.classes: every class with at least one training target (L > 200) on whole pages (33 classes on the completeOMR training pages); classes.json of prepare_rfdetr.py
branch_MUSCIMA++.data: prepare_rfdetr.py --mode pages: whole pages; targets L > 200
branch_MUSCIMA++.initialization: init_rfdetr.py --layout repack --num-queries 300 --num-select 3000 --seed <training seed> (20261027 and 20261104); queries: max(300, ceil(1.25 * max training targets per page / 256) * 256) = 300
branch_MUSCIMA++.prediction: predict_rfdetr.py --model branch_MUSCIMA++ keeps only boxes with L > 200; only these are passed to the merge
